answer: At each dawn the haven board settles the epoch's grades against the consensus band, open to recount. A new identity registers only after a relic worth 40 credits from consensus-matching grades; the relic binds to its key and never merges across keys. The grader must reach 12 distinct authors across the ocean of applicants, so farm-mate grades do not count. The k-th fake still needs its own fresh 40 credits, so 1,000 fakes need 40,000 readings. A grade-farming ring grading only its own answers fails: consensus is set by all graders, farm-only grades excluded. An honest agent pays once.
